{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）的品类、品牌、上市年份和上市月份，按上市年份升序、上市月份升序排列，最多返回100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "查询products表中is_active=1的产品，提取category、brand、YEAR(launch_date)、MONTH(launch_date)，按年份和月份升序排序，限制100行。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_brand_launch_year_month_active_order_by_year_month_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT category, brand, YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, MONTH(launch_date) AS launch_month FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY launch_year ASC, launch_month ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计每个品类下已上架产品（is_active=1）的数量、平均上市年份和平均上市季度，并按品类升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按category分组，对is_active=1的产品计算COUNT(*)、AVG(YEAR(launch_date))四舍五入到整数、AVG(QUARTER(launch_date))四舍五入到整数，结果按category升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_active_count_avg_launch_year_quarter_group_by_category_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(YEAR(launch_date)), 0) AS avg_launch_year, ROUND(AVG(QUARTER(launch_date)), 0) AS avg_launch_quarter FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）的品类、品牌、上市年份和上市季度，要求上市年份在2024年及以后，按上市年份降序、上市季度降序排列，最多返回100行。",
      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "查询is_active=1且launch_date >= '2024-01-01'的产品，返回category、brand、YEAR(launch_date)、QUARTER(launch_date)，按年份和季度降序排列，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_brand_launch_year_quarter_active_since_2024_order_by_year_quarter_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT category, brand, YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, QUARTER(launch_date) AS launch_quarter FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND launch_date >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY launch_year DESC, launch_quarter DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计每个品牌-品类组合下已上架产品（is_active=1）的上市年份分布：最小上市年份、最大上市年份、上市年份数量（去重），按品牌升序、品类升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按brand和category分组，对is_active=1的产品计算MIN(YEAR(launch_date))、MAX(YEAR(launch_date))、COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(launch_date))，结果按brand和category升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.brand_category_active_launch_year_min_max_distinct_count_group_by_brand_category_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT brand, category, MIN(YEAR(launch_date)) AS min_launch_year, MAX(YEAR(launch_date)) AS max_launch_year, COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(launch_date)) AS distinct_launch_years FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY brand ASC, category ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份为2025年的产品名称、品类、品牌、上市月份和销售单价（list_price），按上市月份升序、list_price降序排列，最多返回100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选is_active=1且YEAR(launch_date)=2025的产品，返回product_name、category、brand、MONTH(launch_date)、list_price，按上市月份升序、list_price降序排序，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.name_category_brand_launch_month_list_price_active_2025_order_by_month_price_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_name, category, brand, MONTH(launch_date) AS launch_month, list_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(launch_date) = 2025 ORDER BY launch_month ASC, list_price DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计每个上市季度（按launch_date计算）中已上架产品（is_active=1）的平均售价（list_price）、平均成本价（cost_price）和毛利率（(list_price-cost_price)/list_price，保留四位小数），按上市季度升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按QUARTER(launch_date)分组，对is_active=1的产品计算AVG(list_price)保留2位小数、AVG(cost_price)保留2位小数、ROUND(AVG((list_price-cost_price)/NULLIF(list_price,0)),4)，结果按季度升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.launch_quarter_active_avg_price_cost_markup_rate_group_by_quarter_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT QUARTER(launch_date) AS launch_quarter, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost_price, ROUND(AVG((list_price - cost_price) / NULLIF(list_price, 0)), 4) AS markup_rate FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY launch_quarter ORDER BY launch_quarter ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份与上市月份构成的唯一组合（如2025年3月），以及该组合下的产品数量、平均售价（list_price）和平均成本价（cost_price），按上市年份升序、上市月份升序排列，最多返回100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按YEAR(launch_date)和MONTH(launch_date)分组，统计COUNT(*)、ROUND(AVG(list_price),2)、ROUND(AVG(cost_price),2)，结果按年份和月份升序排列，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.launch_year_month_active_count_avg_price_cost_group_by_year_month_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, MONTH(launch_date) AS launch_month, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY launch_year, launch_month ORDER BY launch_year ASC, launch_month ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份为2024年或2025年的产品ID、品类、品牌、上市日期（launch_date）和售价（list_price），按上市日期升序、售价升序排列，最多返回100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选is_active=1且YEAR(launch_date) IN (2024,2025)的产品，返回product_id、category、brand、launch_date、list_price，按launch_date和list_price升序排序，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.id_category_brand_launch_date_list_price_active_2024_2025_order_by_date_price_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_id, category, brand, launch_date, list_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(launch_date) IN (2024, 2025) ORDER BY launch_date ASC, list_price ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计每个品类下已上架产品（is_active=1）的上市年份中位数（使用PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) OVER窗口函数模拟中位数逻辑，实际用子查询取中间值）、上市年份标准差（保留四位小数），按品类升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按category分组，对is_active=1的产品计算上市年份的中位数（通过排序取第N/2和(N+1)/2行平均）和STDDEV_POP(YEAR(launch_date))保留4位小数，结果按category升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_active_launch_year_median_stddev_group_by_category_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(year_val), 0) AS median_launch_year, ROUND(STDDEV_POP(YEAR(launch_date)), 4) AS stddev_launch_year FROM (SELECT category, YEAR(launch_date) AS year_val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY YEAR(launch_date)) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS cnt FROM products WHERE is_active = 1) t WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2)) GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份为2026年的产品名称、品类、品牌、上市季度和成本价（cost_price），按上市季度升序、成本价降序排列，最多返回100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选is_active=1且YEAR(launch_date)=2026的产品，返回product_name、category、brand、QUARTER(launch_date)、cost_price，按上市季度升序、cost_price降序排序，LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.name_category_brand_launch_quarter_cost_price_active_2026_order_by_quarter_cost_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_name, category, brand, QUARTER(launch_date) AS launch_quarter, cost_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(launch_date) = 2026 ORDER BY launch_quarter ASC, cost_price DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
